Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri October 30, 2020 2:47 pm Full Stack Vs MEAN Stack In this modern and automated marketplace to keep your business run successfully, it is necessary to meet the customers’ current requirements. And for the customers to know your business and go with your services – you need to create a professional website. Here, your website is the heart of your business, which indeed acts in supporting all of your digital marketing ventures. And the website you see on the internet has two sides. The first side is known as the front-end (part of front-end development), which everyone sees, whereas the other side is known as the back-end (part of back-end development), which runs and executes in the background. And to perform the website smoothly, these two aspects should be handled and implemented well. The front-end development consists of the web designing part, and the back-end development handles the database and the server-side programming. And this is where a well-proficient and expert is needed who has excellent experience and knowledge in web development. So, moving ahead, we will understand and learn everything about both these technologies in detail. First, let us know What is Web Development? Web development is designing and development of a website for a company, business, or services. They are divided into two parts: Front-end development Back-end development Front-end Development: This is the client-side development, which manages and controls the website application design by developing the interactive website with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and more. Back-end Development: This is the server-side programming development that handles the database, coding, and scripting a web application. Full-stack web developers are those who know both front-end and back-end development knowledge. Full Stack Vs. MEAN Stack Full-stack web developers know various kinds of programming languages and the tools a developer should know related to front-end and back-end development for a website. On the other hand, Mean Stack is a popular full-stack framework comprised of the most famous JS i.e., Express.JS, MongoDB, NodeJS, and AngularJS. But if we understand, full-stack web development has no limitations to it, but Mean Stack has. As a full-stack web developer, you almost know different languages, web designing concepts, and tools. Hence the demand for full-stack web developers is more where they are offered more packages as well. Also, full-stack developers get more promotions and hiking. What is Full Stack developer, and where do we need them? Full-stack development is granted as one of the famous and in-demand in the present industry, including front end and back end technologies like Java, Ruby, PHP, Python, J2EE, and Perl, and many more. These developers are more demanded in the companies for the higher posts for leading more significant projects. Full Stack Front-end Development Suppose we see the present industry situation and the increasing demand for websites designing for every other business. In that case, front-end technologies are enhancing more popular in the course of project development and products. Product, service, or project is assumed to be more eminent when the users and the customer’s response is positive and satisfying. And this is guaranteed when the best versions of front end development technologies are used. Hence, a full stack developer obliges to master some of the primary front end technologies like HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, and more. And with this, they should know at least the basic knowledge about the famous libraries like SASS, AngularJS, LESS, JQuery, React JS, and more. Learn more at Python Web Development Course Full Stack Back-end Development These developers handle the database and the server-side programming – implementation, and execution as well. It manages and controls the processing to carry out the database by using given user authentications and to display the website content accordingly. As a full-stack back-end developer, one must know in PHP, Python, Node JS, and many more related terms. Always remember that a web application or software cannot be completed without the back end of team support. Why Choose Full Stack? Full Stack Developers create interactive web apps, mobile applications, databases, testing, and many other things using both frontend and backend technology. Formerly, developers with expertise in the fields mentioned above would continue under the same title. Full Stack Developers are in high demand because of the constantly evolving nature of technology and their ability to seamlessly transition between frontend and backend project development. The “Full Stack Developer” profile has gained much popularity due to its numerous benefits. In organizations worldwide, Full Stack Developers are required to carry out several significant tasks. Let’s investigate them: Full Stack Developers create a web application from the ground up without skipping any steps in the process. They should be able to manage any stage of the development process by the specifications and have a solid understanding of the overall design structure. They advance more quickly than others using cutting-edge tools and technologies. Full Stack Developers can quickly solve difficulties and concentrate on issues and their solutions. Full-stack development comes with oceans of benefits attached to it. They perceive & solve issues or problems over different rivulets of website or application development. Companies are now demanding full-stack developers capable o develop complete applications from start to end, step by step. And choosing the right Python Full Stack Developer Course will keep your professional life in safe hands as there is no end for this job profile. It is also a vast topic where you will get a chance to explore and learn new technologies, languages, and tools. Is it hard to learn Full stack development? Being a full-stack developer, sometimes, it is tough to handle and manage the whole website independently. Knowing everything about back-end development and front-end development at times also becomes a terrifying job. Hence, one must have a lot of practice, patience, and determination to learn and execute every step that can occur during a website’s development. You can also give yourself a chance to start a career in python full stack developer post by enhancing your python and full-stack developer skills in bulk. This will help you boost your career to the next level. Full Stack Developers Responsibilities & Requirements The industry now is searching for extremely proficient technical programming language experts and is suitable for working on both platforms, i.e., front-end development & back-end development. A full-stack developer is responsible for inspecting the whole project or program to complete the project with no errors. Hence, one should have all the skills to handle the high pressure, error handling, and other skill-sets that the company expects to have control over the whole project. And this is a real scenario which is carried in every other company which is in search of a full-stack developer. Full Stack Developer Responsibilities Handling all responsiveness of the software or applications Developing front end website architecture Creating servers & databases for better functionality Developing back end website applications Designing & developing APIs Handling cross-platform optimization for all the user devices Working alongside graphic designers for web design features Meeting both technical & consumer needs Staying side by the side of development in web applications and programming languages Designing user interactions on web pages Full Stack Developer Skills Robust company & project management skills Excellent verbal communication skills Good problem-solving skills Full Stack Developer Requirements Computer Science Degree Proficiency with fundamental front end languages like HTML, JavaScript, and more Ease with JavaScript frameworks like Angular JS, React, Amber, and more Expert in handling server-side languages such as Python, Ruby, Java, PHP, and .Net Know about the database technology such as MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, and more Willing to go for a full stack developer course? Then why wait! Start your full stack developer course now as it will help you enhance your future career path and help you upgrade your professional life. Also, there isn’t any worry about the full stack developer jobs as there are many openings worldwide. And every other company needs a developer how can handle both the front-end and back-end development, so there is no limit or expire attached to the full stack developer jobs. |And if your question is how to become a full-stack developer, then reading this – you might have an idea about what precisely full-stack development is and why it is so important nowadays. What is MEAN Stack developer, and where do we need them? Mean Stack is a technology stack that blends all the JavaScript-related terms that are famously used while implementing web-based applications. MEAN technology is where – M means MongoDB, E means ExpressJS, A means AngularJS, and N means NodeJS where MongoDB is a NoSQL database system, ExpressJS is a framework used for developing node-based web applications and Angular JS which is a Google-developed JavaScript framework, and Node JS is a JavaScript roots execution context. All these JS, being a part of mean frameworks, are beneficial and easy to use and understand. In short, mean technology is which handles all the server-side data and coding parts. To check out more Job-Oriented Courses visit 3RI Technologies MEAN Stack Front-end Development All the front end mean applications or Softwares of Mean Stack are developed using Angular JS, JavaScript, and is a mean open-source framework managed by Google. And now, when there is so much demand to know which one is better from a full stack and mean Stack, it is quite clear that Mean stack is readable, easy, and simple to learn. MEAN Stack Back-end Development For the back-end in a mean stack, Node JS is the technology used. Node JS involves Mongoose, which has similar properties like MongoDB object modeling and heads to the website application framework with the help of ExpressJS. Why MEAN Stack? A group of JavaScript-based technologies known as MEAN Stack make it easier to create sophisticated websites and mobile apps that are responsive.Stated otherwise, it is a complete JavaScript framework. The open-source frameworks MongoDB, ExpressJS, AngularJS, and NodeJS make up the MEAN Stack, which makes it easier to create websites and mobile applications. MEAN Stack is the newest and most popular stack development framework with various tools and plugins. It helps developers worldwide focus on the more intricate aspects of project development. Let’s talk about the four complete JavaScript frameworks that make up MEAN Stack. MongoDB: One NoSQL database that can hold a lot of data is MongoDB. It makes use of records and collections. When documents in MongoDB incorporate key-value pair data, collections are functions and documents that mimic relational database tables. ExpressJS: Express is a shared server framework for Node.js programs that facilitates the development of single-, hybrid-, and multi-page online applications. AngularJS: Angular.js is a Model-View-Control framework, similar to JavaScript, that simplifies business development and dynamic online applications. NodeJS: A cross-platform, open-source framework for server-side and networking application development is Node.js. It offers various libraries with various JavaScript models to make application development easier. The following are a few advantages of MEAN Stack Development: It covers every step of building a website, from the front end to the back end, using libraries written in JavaScript. It is compatible with the Model-View-Control (MVC) architecture, which facilitates efficient management of the web development process. It has an extensive built-in toolkit of testing instruments. It keeps the program organized and aids in the removal of pointless bugs during the development process. Why Choose MEAN Stack? The best notable reason to go with Mean Stack is that it uses the same programming languages for front-end and back-end development. You can also go with writing all the technologies in JavaScript, which indeed helps the code be clean and in a readable form. The back-end, i.e., server-side programming, is handled by Node JS, which takes JavaScript to the back-end & the front-end i.e., client-side development with by Angular JS, which takes advantage of reusing the codes wherever necessary. And above all, mean full-stack developers earn a bit more than full-stack developers. Is it too hard to learn MEAN Stack development? Mean Stack is straightforward and simple to understand & learn but is entirely based on JavaScript. Hence, if you are not comfortable or it becomes difficult for you to work with JavaScript, this may take time. But once you learn JavaScript, then you can quickly develop and code your mean stack applications. To study Mean Stack, you should know all the technologies from Mean Stack independently and then combine them to build your applications. This will ultimately help you understand and grasp things easier. Mean Stack Online Training will help you to learn all technologies which come under MEAN Stack. MEAN Stack Developer Responsibilities Skills, & Requirements Mean stack development job positions are way similar to full-stack development. Here, you can develop front-end and back-end systems, built new modules and applications, and many more things. Some of the more job descriptions for mean stack developers are: Basic knowledge and experience in Node JS, Mongo DB, Angular JS & Express JS Design, develop and manage all types of massive, complex databases Establish, refine and integrate development environment tools and software as needed Identify all the production & non-production software or application issues as a part of the deployment Deploy applications on AWS cloud with the ability to debug hosting related topics quickly Architect, Develop, test & deploy robust products that are fast, scalable, and highly responsive How Does MERN Architecture Work? The MERN architecture makes it easier to construct full-stack online apps by symbiotically combining its four essential elements: Express.js, React.js, Node.js, and MongoDB. Client-Side (React.js) React.js manages the application’s client-side or front end. It enables developers to design reusable interactive user interface components. React guarantees a responsive and dynamic user experience by efficiently managing the UI state. Server-Side: Express and Node.js Node.js and the Express.js framework are used on the server side to build a solid backend. When creating RESTful APIs, Express makes handling routing, middleware, and HTTP requests easier. MongoDB database NoSQL database MongoDB uses a flexible format comparable to JSON for storing and retrieving data. Developers can deal with data in a way that best suits the application’s requirements thanks to its smooth integration with the Node.js backend. Communication Through API requests, React.js on the client side interacts with the Node.js backend. Express.js communicates with the MongoDB database to process these requests and return the relevant data to the React.js frontend when necessary. Higher salary package The Same Things About Full Stack and MEAN Stack First, let’s discuss what Full Stack and MEAN Stack have in common. To begin, they both make a person a full-stack coder. You can easily work on both client- and server-side projects once you know how to do either.Learning many programming languages for both the front end and the back end is essential for full-stack developers. You only need to learn a few frameworks for MEAN stack development for the same thing. There is a lot of desire for both of these types of skills. MEAN stack developers are better at working on JavaScript projects, but full-stack coders know more about everything. Because of this, businesses should hire both of them. Among full-stack’s branches is MEAN stack. Learning the MEAN stack correctly is essential if you want to work as a full-stack programmer. The Distinction Between MEAN Stack vs. MERN S. NO. MEAN Stack MERN Stack 1. Angular, Express, Node.js, and MongoDB make up its tech stack. React, Express, Node.js, and MongoDB make up its tech stack. 2. It’s a framework for JavaScript. The JS library is freely available. 3. Typescript is the language used for it. It employs JSX or JavaScript. 4. It provides increased productivity. It has a low productivity level. 5. It has a steep learning curve. It provides significantly superior documentation. 6. It facilitates code management and rendering. It makes rendering smoother. 7. Data flows through it in both directions. It only allows data to go in one direction. 8. It is not compatible with mobile apps. Mobile applications are supported. Popularity of the MEAN Stack vs MERN Stack Choosing a well-known and well-liked technology stack is something you should do for your web development project. However, as many developers would be aware of a popular stack technology, your chances of finding adaptable developers increase if you choose it. In actuality, MEAN vs. MERN Stack has gained popularity because of the contrast between Angular and React. Over time, the AngularJS framework has become more and more well-known for creating responsive online applications.However, React’s impact on front-end development has been revolutionary in recent years. According to a HackerRank Developer Skills report, 30% of developers polled said they were aware of Angular, making it the most widely used web framework in the developer community. React, however, came in second place because 26% of developers claimed to be familiar with the framework. Nevertheless, things changed in 2019. According to the same survey, thirty percent of developers were keen to master React technology. This reached the widely read one. However, the proportion of Angular developers fell to 20%, suggesting that React is now more popular than Angular. Regarding the current situation, 74.5% of developers polled said they would use React instead, making it the most popular and well-liked framework. However, Angular is only in ninth place because of its 57.6% developer population. Angular and React are, to put it briefly, both widely recognized and popular. Hiring React developers instead of Angular developers becomes considerably simpler, though. Provides various ready-to-use features Needs more libraries to handle requests that are similar. Full-stack vs. MEAN stack Salary If we see the overall records on the recruiting sites, we can say no difference in the full-Stack vs. mean stack salary package. The average salary paid in India for a full-stack developer is around 6.95 per annum approx. And that for a mean-stack developer is about 9.1 per annum approx. Takeaway Understanding the exact difference between Mean stack and Full stack development, you can decide on your own whether you want to go for which development side – according to your skills and interests. There is no such a thing that which is better, mean Stack or full-Stack? If you are interested in one and want to pursue your career in that, you can go ahead with that. Also, reading this blog, you might have got everything clear in your mind about it. But if you pick one from Full Stack Course in Pune or MEAN Stack Course in Pune , having knowledge and experience will always help you develop yourself and move towards a better professional career.
